_doctrine: THE MANUAL TRAJECTORY — the ghost's editorial sort, authored by reading (not scoring) every chapter's beats + voltage. Rules applied: beats give the tutorial spine; each voltage piece is placed where it lands hardest (hook / peak / close), not appended; deliberate inversions allowed (complexity early when the drama wants it, simplicity late as reduction); questions and arrivals are protected openers; the close is chosen for affect (grief, archive, stillness), not completeness. Compare with tools/compare_orders.py.
